page.layout: One page of a scan: a stained, blank leaf with rust-coloured foxing, a long diagonal crease, and paper repair strips along the left edge. Small fragments of printed or manuscript text are visible only at the far left edge (upper left and near the lower left), too fragmentary to read. A small mark "12A" appears at the left edge, mid-height. A faint digitiser watermark sits at the lower right corner and is excluded.
page.notes: No legible printed text on this page. The left-edge strips show only scraps of letters that cannot be read with any certainty, so nothing is transcribed. The "12A" mark at the left edge is a shelf or handwritten mark and is excluded. The lower-right watermark is a digitiser's banner and is excluded.
